title: Maximum separation value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 12 m.

title: Communication duration value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 4.8 s.

title: Equal velocities condition
description: Important: The solution must identify that maximum separation occurs when the velocities of the two cars are equal.

title: Separation function setup
description: Important: The relative displacement function s(t) = d + (v₀t + ½a₁t²) - ½a₂t² must be correctly established.

title: Solving for s₀ times
description: Important: The two times (2 s and 6 s) when the separation equals 10 m must be found by solving the quadratic equation from s(t)=s₀.

title: Meeting time calculation
description: Important: The time T when the cars meet (separation=0) must be correctly calculated, yielding T = 8.8 s.

title: Duration logic
description: Optional: The reasoning that the communication window before meeting is T - (t₂ - t₁) should be clearly explained.

title: Sign error in separation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the relative displacement formula uses the wrong sign for the acceleration terms or initial positions.

title: Ignoring initial separation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the initial distance d = 4.0 m is omitted from the separation function.
